description: Spec 018 (phase 6, SRD Annex C §C.13): calibrated uncertainty of the fused tracker (decision 32's -g1 IMM with the frozen T2's range, k 4, every 6; stated sds under -sd) against the -g1 reference IMM, judged at G7 on fresh seed 215 (400,000; its 40,000-scenario test split, generated alone). Nothing is trained: the dataset (seed 211) supplies the normalisation for T2's derived features, and the plan pins the fresh test digest that tma-g7 checks.
